producer_note: Hand-curated. Each date was read on the regulator's own page (or official journal / official data endpoint) at retrieved_at; the evidence_quote is the text that states it. Edit by PR with a fresh retrieval, never by retyping a date.

status_rule.VERIFIED: date read verbatim on the official source at retrieved_at, and still ahead
status_rule.CLOSED: a door (consultation, call, competition) whose date has passed — kept for the record
status_rule.IN_EFFECT: an application or publication date that has passed
status_rule.UNVERIFIED: no official source stating a date could be read; date is null by rule, never guessed

verification_rule: verification.lane_refetch records a second, independent fetch of the same official URL by the governor lane on 2026-09-14 (FOUND = the evidence text was present in the bytes). Items with lane_refetch NOT_DONE rest on one fetch only and say so.

alerts.also_flags: VERIFIED items whose date has passed (the file needs re-statusing)

doors.instrument: EU AI Act, Article 113 — application of Article 50 transparency obligations
doors.evidence_quote: It shall apply from 2 August 2026. However: (a) Chapters I and II shall apply from 2 February 2025; (b) Chapter III Section 4, Chapter V, Chapter VII and Chapter XII and Article 78

doors.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2026/1744 of 8 July 2026 — transitional period for Article 50(2) marking
doors.evidence_quote: Providers of AI systems, including general-purpose AI systems, generating synthetic audio, image, video or text content, that have been placed on the market before 2 August 2026 shall take the necessary steps in order to comply with Article 50(2) by 2 December 2026.

verification.method: Publications Office Cellar XHTML of OJ L 2026/1744 (24.7.2026)

doors.notes: Adopted. This is not a general postponement of Article 50: it gives Article 50(2) marking only a grace period, and only for systems already on the market before 2 August 2026.
